Get attributes or codes with attributes

Source: R/attributes.R
attributes.Rd

These functions traverse the relationship graph to find attributes for codes or codes that have specific attributes.

Usage

ATTRIBUTES_FOR(
  ...,
  type = getOption("codeminer.code_type"),
  lookup_version = getOption("codeminer.lookup_version", default = "latest"),
  relationship_version = getOption("codeminer.relationship_version", default = "latest"),
  relationship_types = NULL,
  preferred_description_only = TRUE,
  col_filters = "default"
)

HAS_ATTRIBUTES(
  ...,
  type = getOption("codeminer.code_type"),
  lookup_version = getOption("codeminer.lookup_version", default = "latest"),
  relationship_version = getOption("codeminer.relationship_version", default = "latest"),
  relationship_types = NULL,
  preferred_description_only = TRUE,
  col_filters = "default"
)

Arguments

...

Codes to start from. Supports flexible input like CODES().

type

Code type (character).

lookup_version

Lookup table version (character).

relationship_version

Relationship table version (character).

relationship_types

Character vector of relationship types to filter by. If NULL (default), all relationship types are included.

preferred_description_only

Logical. If TRUE, return only preferred descriptions.

col_filters

Column filters to apply. See CODES() for details.

Value

A data frame of codes and descriptions

Details

  • ATTRIBUTES_FOR() returns attribute codes for the supplied codes

  • HAS_ATTRIBUTES() returns codes that have the specified attribute codes

See also

Other Code relationships: parent_child_retrieval, relationship_types
